prompt.zh-CN: 面试官要一个单进程、带 TTL 的内存 KV，30 分钟内写完。过期条目怎么处理最合适？
prompt.en-US: The interviewer wants a single-process in-memory KV store with TTL, written in 30 minutes. How should expired entries be handled?

scenario.zh-CN: 读多写少，键数量在十万以内，测试会用假时钟推进时间。
scenario.en-US: Read-heavy, under 100k keys, and the tests advance a fake clock.

text.zh-CN: 读时惰性检查并删除过期条目
text.en-US: Check and evict lazily on read

why.zh-CN: 实现最简单、完全确定，假时钟一推进，下一次读就能看到结果。
why.en-US: Simplest and fully deterministic: the next read after the fake clock advances sees the expiry.

text.zh-CN: 每个键起一个定时线程到期删除
text.en-US: Start a timer thread per key that deletes it

why.zh-CN: 线程数随键数增长，且真实计时器不受假时钟控制，测试会变得不确定。
why.en-US: Threads grow with keys, and real timers ignore the fake clock, so tests become nondeterministic.

text.zh-CN: 不删除，靠进程重启清理
text.en-US: Never evict; rely on process restarts

why.zh-CN: 过期的值仍会被读到，直接违反 TTL 契约。
why.en-US: Expired values stay readable, which breaks the TTL contract outright.

explanation.zh-CN: 面试场景优先“正确且确定”。惰性过期满足契约；如果追问内存占用，再补一个按写入次数触发的批量清扫。
explanation.en-US: In an interview, correct and deterministic wins. Lazy expiry meets the contract; if asked about memory, add a sweep triggered every N writes.

hints.zh-CN: 哪种方案在假时钟下依然确定？
hints.en-US: Which option stays deterministic under a fake clock?
